context: Two students debate a paper between sessions
purpose: Critique a paper; teach 語る/挙げ/現れ/間違っ/許さ/それとも

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この論文、語る部分が面白いね。
lines.en: The part of this paper that speaks out is interesting.
lines.style: engaged peer praising the argument, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 根拠を挙げてないところが気になる。
lines.en: The spots with no evidence given bother me.
lines.style: sharp peer spotting a weakness, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かに、例を挙げるべきだね。
lines.style: agreeing peer conceding the point, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 結論に矛盾が現れてる。
lines.en: A contradiction appears in the conclusion.
lines.style: analytical peer pinpointing the flaw, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どこか間違ってる気がする。
lines.en: I feel something is wrong somewhere.
lines.style: puzzled peer voicing his doubt, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私も間違ってると思った。
lines.en: I thought it was mistaken too.
lines.style: confirming peer sharing the view, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも頭ごなしに許さないのもよくない。
lines.en: But flatly refusing to forgive it is also bad.
lines.style: fair-minded peer urging balance, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 批判する、それとも提案する？
lines.style: decisive peer framing the choice, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それとも両方やる？ 自分の考えを語るのが先かな。
lines.en: Or do both? Maybe speaking our own view comes first.
lines.style: constructive peer suggesting a path, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新しい視点が現れたね。
lines.style: pleased peer noting their progress, tone holding steady through the whole line
